vulnerabilities.weakness: Stateful data lost on pod restart
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the redis-cart pod is killed, the cart data disappears, causing checkout failures
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: stateful without a persistent volume: a restart loses data

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the productcatalogservice pod is killed, all pages that request catalog data fail
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every page needs: one pod failure takes the site down

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the cartservice pod is killed, cart operations and page rendering fail
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every page needs: one pod failure takes the site down
vulnerabilities.severity_after_fix: critical → medium (2 replicas, so one pod failure is absorbed; every page still needs it (no PDB or HPA))

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the currencyservice pod is killed, price calculations fail and pages break
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every page needs: one pod failure takes the site down

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the frontend pod is killed, the entire site becomes unavailable
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every page needs: one pod failure takes the site down
vulnerabilities.severity_after_fix: critical → medium (2 replicas, so one pod failure is absorbed; every page still needs it (no PDB or HPA))

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the paymentservice pod is killed, checkout cannot complete payments
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every purchase needs: one pod failure stops checkout

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the shippingservice pod is killed, checkout cannot calculate shipping and fails
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every purchase needs: one pod failure stops checkout

vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the checkoutservice pod is killed, all purchase flows fail
vulnerabilities.severity_reason: single replica that every purchase needs: one pod failure stops checkout

systemic: All services lack pod disruption budgets, horizontal pod autoscaling, and most are single‑replica deployments. This makes the entire stack vulnerable to pod failures, scaling events, and resource contention.
